title: pittosporum tenuifolium var. fasciculatum
intro: Pittosporum tenuifolium var. fasciculatum, commonly known as Blacksmith or Kohuhu, is a plant species in the family Pittosporaceae, native to New Zealand. The leaves of this plant have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pittosporum tenuifolium var. fasciculatum include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
